title: GeoTIFF
description: Georeferencing of TIFF images by the OGC GeoTIFF standard 1.1 (https://docs.ogc.org/is/19-008r4/19-008r4.html), which also covers GeoTIFF 1.0 files. Tags place the raster in model space; keys of the GeoKeyDirectoryTag, decoded into `geo_keys`, name its coordinate reference system. Keys have their GeoTIFF 1.1 names; renamed GeoTIFF 1.0 names are noted. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

ModelPixelScaleTag.title: Pixel scale
ModelPixelScaleTag.description: Size of a pixel in model (CRS) units along x, y and z. Tag 33550.

ModelTiepointTag.title: Tie points
ModelTiepointTag.description: Points tying raster positions (i, j, k) to model positions (x, y, z), six values per point. Tag 33922.

ModelTransformationTag.title: Model transformation
ModelTransformationTag.description: A 4 × 4 affine matrix from raster to model space, used instead of pixel scale and tie point for rotated or sheared rasters. Tag 34264.
